searchText: Announcement🚨 : `merge-devnet-1` will be shut down tomorrow ~12PM CEST. If there are any objections to the shutdown, please do let me know. In the meantime, please migrate your testing to `merge-devnet-2`. I do have extra validator keys in case anyone wants to run their own validator. Otherwise you can get eth from the faucet and make a deposit for your own validator. re-sharing links for easy access: Configs: https://github.com/eth2-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/merge-devnet-2 beacon explorer: https://beaconchain.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ execution explorer: https://explorer.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ faucet: https://faucet.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ forkmon: https://forkmon.merge-devnet-2.wenmerge.dev/ is eth.syncing broken in the devnet(-2) ? it returns false for me - but I am not synced currently at: ``` > eth.blockNumber 5955 ``` but explorer reports higher Syncing only shows true/info if there's a sync in progress. Your node probably don't know that there is a higher chain, so it doesn't know that it should sync. Which CL are you running? running teku now but syncing seems in progress - getting new blocks in now at 6061 For the Teku team: I'm getting a bunch of these errors ```` 2021-12-01 12:43:41.842 ERROR - Total Difficulty of Terminal Block parent is invalid! Must be lower than TTD! ``` I've first started a geth node which was already synced past TTD by a lighthouse node, then shutdown the lighthouse node and started Teku. Teku reorged the already synced node ``` INFO [12-01|12:45:55.283] Setting head head=7aad3b..dbc271 ERROR[12-01|12:45:55.352] Impossible reorg, please file an issue oldnum=3594 oldhash=7aad3b..dbc271 oldblocks=3714 newnum=3594 newhash=7aad3b..dbc271 newblocks=0 ``` And started full syncing (inserting each block and setting head) from there. The error subsequently went away, but I think this not good behavior to replay all blocks after TTD (might be because of non-optimistic sync though) Alright, the same thing happened with Lighthouse too. ``` INFO [12-01|13:05:36.343] Inserted block number=7408 hash=7e55c8..b925c2 txs=0 elapsed="175.109µs" INFO [12-01|13:05:36.358] Setting head head=7e55c8..b925c2 INFO [12-01|13:05:36.358] Set the chain head number=7408 hash=7e55c8..b925c2 INFO [12-01|13:05:47.484] Setting head head=f7db84..07220e ERROR[12-01|13:05:47.493] Impossible reorg, please file an issue oldnum=7308 oldhash=f7db84..07220e oldblocks=100 newnum=7308 newhash=f7db84..07220e newblocks=0 INFO [12-01|13:05:47.494] Set the chain head number=7308 hash=f7db84..07220e ``` To reproduce: Start lh-geth Stop lh Start teku with same geth Let it run for a while Stop teku, start LH LH will reorg EL to the last block that it saw Right now these issues are not really visible, since we don't have much state on the network. On mainnet a block reorg of 1 hours worth of blocks, and then re-applying the same 1 hour of blocks will take at least 2 minutes seems difficulty() returns 0 - would expect a random number now No, difficulty will stay 0, the randomness is stored in the mixhash of the block I mean the opcode Or do you mean in contracts? In contracts the difficulty opcode should return the randomness now this contract: 0xFB20858f8F5D450FA7bB9E88BD89f37282D8534b Hey guys excuse the noob question. Running into error when trying to run "make geth" Do you have `go` installed? check with `go version` Perfect! Ran into another error now lol I just had the same error, and this thread fixed it for me: https://forum.restic.net/t/malformed-module-path-hash-maphash/4389/3 sudo add-apt-repository ppa:longsleep/golang-backports sudo apt update sudo apt install golang-go Awesome. Fixed it for me as well. Thanks Ian. So I'm trying to run the second command in the connect GETH-LH And I received an error and noticed this It's referencing the wrong chain ID, I think the new chain ID was changed to 1337402 Is there a specific file I can modify to fix this? Actually, scratch that. Just noticed the error. Since I copied and pasted the command. I've updated the DNS records to point to a new, more stable reverse proxy for all the tooling links sent earlier. Pardon any funky behaviour while DNS settles down.

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
For the Teku team:
I'm getting a bunch of these errors
````
2021-12-01 12:43:41.842 ERROR - Total Difficulty of Terminal Block parent is invalid! Must be lower than TTD!
``` 
I've first started a geth node which was already synced past TTD by a lighthouse node, then shutdown the lighthouse node and started Teku.
Teku reorged the already synced node 
```
INFO [12-01|12:45:55.283] Setting head                             head=7aad3b..dbc271
ERROR[12-01|12:45:55.352] Impossible reorg, please file an issue   oldnum=3594 oldhash=7aad3b..dbc271 oldblocks=3714 newnum=3594 newhash=7aad3b..dbc271 newblocks=0
```
And started full syncing (inserting each block and setting head) from there. 
The error subsequently went away, but I think this not good behavior to replay all blocks after TTD (might be because of non-optimistic sync though)

excerpts.content:
Alright, the same thing happened with Lighthouse too.
```
INFO [12-01|13:05:36.343] Inserted block                           number=7408 hash=7e55c8..b925c2 txs=0   elapsed="175.109µs"
INFO [12-01|13:05:36.358] Setting head                             head=7e55c8..b925c2
INFO [12-01|13:05:36.358] Set the chain head                       number=7408 hash=7e55c8..b925c2
INFO [12-01|13:05:47.484] Setting head                             head=f7db84..07220e
ERROR[12-01|13:05:47.493] Impossible reorg, please file an issue   oldnum=7308 oldhash=f7db84..07220e oldblocks=100  newnum=7308 newhash=f7db84..07220e newblocks=0
INFO [12-01|13:05:47.494] Set the chain head                       number=7308 hash=f7db84..07220e
```
To reproduce: 
Start lh-geth 
Stop lh
Start teku with same geth
Let it run for a while
Stop teku, start LH
LH will reorg EL to the last block that it saw
